uncertainties.zh: B处关闭木门后是否为卧室、床的位置如何，尚未确认；但已观测到的掉头返回与任务要求的尽头右转相冲突。
uncertainties.en: Whether the closed wooden door at B leads to the bedroom and where the bed is remain unconfirmed; nevertheless, the observed reversal conflicts with the task's required right turn at the end of the hallway.

segment_summary.zh: 从A处木柜/置物架旁进入前方走廊，沿走廊直行到尽头窗前；在窗前附近转向后，视线转为回望来路的大开间/客厅，墙面挂画相对A帧换到另一侧，显示机器人掉头返回，而非在尽头右转进入下一段走廊。随后到达一扇关闭的木门前，左侧可见浅色矮柜，未见卧室或床。
segment_summary.en: From beside the wooden cabinet/shelf at A, the robot entered the hallway ahead and went straight to the window at the end; after turning near the window, the view looked back toward the large open/living area along the incoming route, and the wall artwork appeared on the opposite side relative to frame A, indicating it reversed back instead of turning right into the next hallway at the end. It then reached a closed wooden door, with a light-colored low cabinet visible on the left and no bedroom or bed in view.

reason.zh: 任务要求在走廊尽头右转，继续经过左侧卫生间并进入卧室；但F59/F73已到尽头窗前，F87却回望来路客厅且挂画方位反转，支持掉头返回；B处仅有闭合木门、无床，未显示进入卧室。该掉头与右转前进要求直接冲突。
reason.en: The task requires a right turn at the end of the hallway, then continuing past the bathroom on the left into the bedroom; however, frames 59/73 already reach the window at the end, while frame 87 looks back toward the living area along the incoming route with the artwork on the opposite side, supporting a reversal. At B there is only a closed wooden door and no bed, so entry into the bedroom is not shown. This reversal directly conflicts with the required right turn and forward progress.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Enter the bedroom ahead, and stop in front of the bed.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 进入前方的卧室，并在床前停下。

description.en: Frames 44–45 show the robot beside the wooden cabinet/shelf facing the opening ahead; frames 59 and 73 show it at the window at the end, indicating it walked along the hallway to the window.

description.zh: 该帧从走廊回望大开间/客厅；同一墙面挂画相对F44出现在相反侧，支持其掉头沿原路返回，而不是在尽头右转进入新走廊。
description.en: This frame looks back from the hallway toward the large open/living area; the framed wall art appears on the opposite side relative to frame 44, supporting a reversal back along the same route rather than a right turn into the next hallway at the end.
